AI COSTS AND VALUE CAPTURE | G2, G4-G6
Reported-structure axis: revenue lines and cost placement
|
|-- Sidekick usage -[D:claim]-> merchant success
|   |-- [S] More merchant acquisition benefits Subscription Solutions.
|   `-- [S] More merchant sales benefit Merchant Solutions.
|-- [S] Sidekick costs sit in Subscription Solutions.
|   `-- [I] Cost location alone does not measure whole-company AI returns.
|
|-- Subscription Solutions gross margin (management figures)
|   |-- [S] Q3 2025: 81.7%; hosting/AI pressure, support offsets.
|   |-- [S] Q1 2026: 80%; increased LLM costs partly offset by efficiencies.
|   `-- [S] Q3 2026: 79%.
|       |-- [S] YoY compression primarily incremental Sidekick AI spend.
|       `-- [S] Sequential decline mainly hosting/capacity/resiliency costs.
|
|-- Q2 -> Q3 2026 delivery efficiency
|   |-- [S] Conversations +14%; cost per conversation -28%.
|   |-- [S] Total Sidekick cost -18%.
|   |-- [I] Rounded arithmetic: 1.14 x 0.72 = 0.8208, about -18%.
|   `-- [S] Model selection, distillation and caching support lower costs.
|
|-- Internal tooling has another cost location
|   `-- [S] Q2 2026: majority of internal AI spend allocated to R&D.
|
`-- Agentic orders -[D:claim]-> revenue through existing economics
    |-- [S] No separate agentic pricing or fees.
    `-- [I] Absolute agentic revenue, incremental margin and AI ROI unknown.

[I] Do not attribute every subscription margin movement to Sidekick.
[I] A lower unit cost does not by itself prove a positive investment return.
